table_value: VL slot (0 N, 1 E, 2 S, 3 W)
note: balanced (4/4/4/4) minimum-distance assignment of the 16 routers of a 4x4 chiplet to its 4 VLs; the paper-style second (entry) selection for uniform demand, keyed by the destination router. The same table serves as the nearest-VL entry of DeFT-Dis/RC with ties broken for balance. near_counts = loads of the `near` policy (ties to the lowest VL id).
